scenes.name: The Monkees
scenes.author: Jon Savage
scenes.desc: El pop aborrece el vacío: justo cuando los Beatles desaparecían, la industria promocionó su simulacro, cuatro chicos guapos reunidos tras mucha investigación para protagonizar una serie de televisión a lo A Hard Day’s Night. «Last Train to Clarksville», un acróstico contagioso de «Paperback Writer» con el tema oportuno de las despedidas forzosas de Vietnam, llegó al número 1. Si los Beatles no estaban, la industria los clonaría, y a los adolescentes más jóvenes les daba igual.

podcast.title: Manchester Origins
podcast.body: Davy Jones, the singer of The Monkees, is cited as having Manchester origins, contributing to the city's rich musical history. "the singer of David Jones, the monkeys, you know, the singer of the monkeys has some mancise."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Oral History of Manchester Part 2

podcast.title: Real Musician in Fictional Band
podcast.body: Davy Jones was a real person, an actor and musician, who was hired to play a fictional musician within The Monkees, a band created for a television show. "But... Davy Jones... these were real people. They were actors and musicians hired to pay fictional musicians seemingly inspired by the Beatles."
